description: Fuzzy string matching for entity resolution, dedupe and "did you mean": match one or many queries against up to 5,000 choices with RapidFuzz-style scorers (WRatio weighted blend, ratio / InDel similarity, partial_ratio, token_sort, token_set, Jaro-Winkler, normalised Levenshtein, Damerau / OSA). Default preprocessing lowercases, folds accents and strips punctuation. Returns top matches with 0-100 scores and choice index, optional per-scorer breakdown. Offline, deterministic. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fuzzy-match

normalize.description: Lowercase, fold accents, strip punctuation first
